claims.claim: Nasser Gholami, 47, of Brampton, is charged with multiple firearm-related offences by CBSA
Gholami is a Toronto Police constable with seven years of service
A U.S.-originated parcel containing two complete firearm suppressors was intercepted at CBSA's Mississauga facility on July 23, 2026
OFSET executed a search warrant at Gholami's Brampton home on Sept. 24, 2026, seizing three non-restricted firearms, a prohibited suppressor attached to a firearm, digital devices and ammunition

Gholami faces four counts: smuggling prohibited devices, importing prohibited devices while unauthorized, possession of a prohibited device without a licence, and unsafe display of a non-restricted firearm
Gholami is suspended with pay and has been notified the chief intends to suspend him without pay after the mandated 60-day period
TPS says the CBSA charges are unrelated to Gholami's duties as a Toronto Police officer
Next court appearance is set for Nov. 5, 2026 at Brampton Courthouse
None of the allegations have been tested in court; Gholami is presumed innocent
